thread:
marta: Quick accessibility run: when opening the invoke panel with VoiceOver the focus sequence jumps (title -> close -> last param). Repro'd on Safari/Mac.
ryan: interesting. could be DOM order vs visual reflow. is this only on narrow viewports?
marta: no, repro on desktop width too. steps: open playground -> pick fn -> click 'Invoke' -> VO+RightArrow. lands on "Close" instead of first param.
samir: likely missing tabindex management on the close button. quick fix: move close after heading in DOM but visually position it with absolute CSS, or set tabindex=-1 and manage focus programmatically.
olivia: UX/copy nit: we've got both "Invoke" and "Run" in different places. for clarity and a11y let's pick one visible label. propose: use "Invoke" everywhere in the playground.
ryan: +1 to standardize. avoid different visible labels across flows. tooltips can say "Run (Invoke)" if we need extra context.
marta: contrast issue: timeline badges in the run history are failing AA on dark theme. current #2b6cb0 is borderline. suggestion #245a9a gives 4.6:1.
samir: noted. i'll update theming tokens in the PR.
olivia: small screen-reader enhancement: read the variant name in run-summary, e.g., "Run 4, variant: summarize-with-images" — right now it's hidden behind an expander. we can add a sr-only span.
ryan: and add a keyboard shortcut to open the latest run (Cmd+I) so power users can get there instantly. add to Help menu.
marta: can we have an aria-live confirmation for "Copy to prompt" action? SR users currently get no feedback.
samir: yes, will add aria-live=\"polite\" to the toast and ensure it has text content when activated.
olivia: thinking about naming consistency in code: UI calls it "Invocation panel" but some CSS/ids use "invoke-inspector". i'd prefer product copy be "Invoke panel" and keep short ids for dev.
ryan: fine: visible label "Invoke panel", code IDs can stay compact like "invoke-panel". avoid mismatches between copy and code names.
marta: can someone add a minimal VoiceOver smoke test to CI? steps: open playground, invoke panel, focus first param, toggle a param, confirm history updated.
samir: i can add a small e2e that runs only under macos-labs. will include a tiny screencast.
ryan: timeline: keep this to aria attributes + copy + color token tweak. aim for a patch release this week.
devex-bot: issue created: DEVEX-2042 "Invoke panel: VoiceOver focus order, label standardization, and contrast fixes" -> https://issues.redwood/DEVEX-2042
marta: thanks everyone. i'll verify VO once the PR lands. :thumbsup:
ryan: thanks team, small but high impact.
